profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am an experienced software engineer with 5+ years of industry experience in a variety of fields including financial technology, test automation, flight simulators, and real-time embedded systems.  I enjoy problem solving and taking on new challenges. My passion for knowledge has led me to pursue dual BS degrees in Computer Engineering and Computer Science as well as a MS degree in Computer Science. I am currently working in the aerospace field developing real-time, safety-critical navigation systems for aircrafts.

positions.description: Skills: Git · Python · C · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · C++ · Engineering · Microsoft Office · Microsoft PowerPoint · Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) · Time Management · Windows · Jira · Teamwork · Ada Programming Language · Embedded Systems · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a GUI application in Python to ease the process of updating configuration files for training simulators
•	Increased performance of a simulator by 50% through preliminary ATP software testing
•	Provided technical support to senior-level engineers 
•	Updated project drawings and documentations
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Python · C · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · C++ · Engineering · Microsoft Office · Time Management · Windows · Teamwork · Software Design

positions.title: Quality Assurance Test Automation Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed automated test scripts with Python using Selenium and the pytest testing framework 
•	Created functions for accessing different elements on the business management application to be used in constructing test scripts
•	Maintained the testing framework with new updates by utilizing XPath to build page fragments of new application aspects
•	Improved application functionality through tracking quality assurance metrics and notifying the development team of defects
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Python · Engineering · Microsoft Office · Time Management · Windows · Teamwork · Software Design

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed a React UI used by developers across the company
•	Implemented REST API endpoints in a Spring Boot back-end and API calls in the front-end UI
•	Utilized the Kanban methodology on an agile team to efficiently manage the UI development process
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Java · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Engineering · Microsoft Office · Microsoft PowerPoint · Time Management · Windows · Jira · Teamwork · Software Design

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant (Supervised under Dr. Sang-Hie Lee)
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a C++ software to read MIDI data from a piano, decode the data into standard musical parameters, and output the information into a text file
•	Assisted in data analysis to figure out the best hand movements for playing piano to minimize hand injuries
•	Provided feedback to participants by organizing the analyzed data into Word documents
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Word · C++ · Engineering · Microsoft Office · Microsoft PowerPoint · Time Management · Windows · Teamwork · Visual Studio · Software Design

company.name: University of South Florida Department of Arts and Music

positions.title: STEM Mentor
positions.description:
•	Inspired underprivileged middle school students to get more involved in STEM fields by organizing related events and activities
•	Designed and built a replica of a disaster relief robot and an autonomous boat with the mentees
•	Refined the mentees’ teamwork skill by planning team-building activities
